newsitem.title: USA: Dean Foods up on strong Q2 EPS - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Dean Foods up on strong Q2 EPS - analyst.

text.p: Dean Foods Co shares traded up 2-1/8 at 28-1/4 on Thursday after the company reported stronger than expected fiscal second quarter earnings that indicated a turnaround at the food company, an analyst said.
Trading had been delayed due to an imbalance.
"It's more of a confirmation that things are finally starting to turn around," Piper Jaffray analyst George Dahlman said.
Dean Foods said earnings in its vegetable, pickles and specialty segments all exceed last year's second quarter results, while the dairy segment was below last year as expected.
Earlier, Dean Foods reported second quarter net earnings of $0.47 a share, up from $0.40 a year ago.
According to First Call, the mean estimate for the second quarter was $0.42 a share, with a range of estimates of $0.37 to $0.45 a share.
